methods.label: Standard-form asymptote slopes
methods.explanation: Assuming the hyperbola's axes are parallel to the coordinate axes, as in the recorded standard-form convention, the asymptote slopes are \(\pm b/a\) or \(\pm a/b\), depending on orientation. Since \(a=b=5\), both ratios equal \(5/5=1\). Thus the absolute value of each asymptote's slope is \(1\).
